You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 82.8%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 72.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 92.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 31.4%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.

            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens

candidates.title: Story screen carousel layout redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story introduction screen to use a carousel layout that lets users browse through visual slides explaining the app concept.
candidates.why: The choose_path stage has a long mean duration of 514s, indicating users pause or get distracted on entry before picking a creation path.

story.headline: Discover Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Swipe through the story of how your pet lives right on your desktop desktop companion journey.

candidates.title: Account pet sync overview new screen in sign in
candidates.change: Inserts a brief informational card screen right before sign-in explaining that creating an account prevents losing pet data across restarts.
candidates.why: Support receives 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account pet persistence the single largest support complaint.

new_sync_overview.headline: Keep Your Desktop Pet Safe
new_sync_overview.body: Sign in on the next step to ensure your companion's traits, name, and history are backed up securely.

candidates.title: Pick friend carousel layout redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend screen to use a carousel layout for browsing pet companions smoothly.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 72.4% conversion and mean time of 1017s, showing significant friction during pet selection.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Friend
pick_friend.body: Browse through available pet companions to find your perfect desk partner.

candidates.title: Desktop pet placement readiness new flow
candidates.change: Adds a workspace environment readiness flow before home intro to verify desktop layer setup and screen compatibility.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop or the app failing to open, while home wait times average 2336s.

new_desktop_placement_prep.headline: Preparing Desktop Workspace
new_desktop_placement_prep.body: Verifying screen bounds and background layer so your pet renders cleanly on top of windows.

components.text: Screen resolution check, Window layering check, Transparency test

candidates.title: Home intro desktop pet interaction control headline update
candidates.change: Updates the headline on the final welcome screen to clearly tell users how to access desktop pet controls via right-click.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets cited confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.

home_intro.headline: Right-Click Your Pet Anytime to Access Desktop Controls
home_intro.body: Use the right-click menu or tray icon to adjust pet visibility, volume, and desktop behaviors.

candidates.title: Choose path desktop companion quick hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint text below the path selection options clarifying the difference between pre-made pets and custom photo generation.
candidates.why: Choosing a path takes a mean 514s, indicating initial hesitation when deciding how to proceed.

choose_path.hint: Select whether to pick from pre-made pet companions or generate a custom creation from your own photos.

candidates.title: Sign in pet restoration focus body copy update
candidates.change: Rewords the sign-in screen copy to focus specifically on protecting saved pets from accidental resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were reported regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe
sign_in.body: Link your account to restore your desktop pet anytime and prevent pet data resets across reloads.

candidates.title: Upload photos quality selection clarity hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the photo upload screen recommending clear lighting and single subjects for optimal custom pet generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet creation failures or poor graphic results.

upload_photos.hint: For best custom rendering results, use clear photos with balanced lighting and a single focused subject.

candidates.title: Waiting screen step counter display toggle
candidates.change: Enables the step counter indicator on the waiting screen so users can track rendering progress stages.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a 92.2% conversion but a high mean wait time of 2336s, causing user uncertainty.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Companion Desktop Asset
waiting.body: Your companion is being assembled and calibrated for desktop display.

candidates.title: Home intro split layout setup guide
candidates.change: Changes the home intro screen layout to split view, separating welcome visuals from interactive control instructions.
candidates.why: The finish step drops to 64.8% conversion with users failing to complete onboarding due to post-setup control confusion.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your New Pet to the Desktop
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your screen. Learn how to interact, minimize, or adjust settings at any time.
